Exercise 15.7.39 — Mass and Center of Mass Under a Plane

Problem. Find the mass and center of mass of the solid EEE with the given density function ρ\rhoρ. EEE is the solid that lies under the plane z=1+x+yz = 1 + x + yz=1+x+y and above the region in the xyxyxy-plane bounded by the curves y=xy = \sqrt{x}y=x​, y=0y = 0y=0, and x=1x = 1x=1; ρ(x,y,z)=2\rho(x,y,z) = 2ρ(x,y,z)=2.

Part 1 — Mass and center of mass

Step 1.1: Describe the solid and choose the order.

The base DDD is the region between the xxx-axis (y=0)(y=0)(y=0) and the parabola y=xy=\sqrt{x}y=x​ from x=0x=0x=0 to x=1x=1x=1. It is simplest to hold xxx fixed and let yyy run from 000 to x\sqrt{x}x​. The height at each point is 0≤z≤1+x+y0 \le z \le 1+x+y0≤z≤1+x+y. Thus 0≤x≤1,0≤y≤x,0≤z≤1+x+y. 0 \le x \le 1, \qquad 0 \le y \le \sqrt{x}, \qquad 0 \le z \le 1 + x + y. 0≤x≤1,0≤y≤x​,0≤z≤1+x+y.

Step 1.2: Compute the mass.

First collapse the zzz-integration. Since ρ=2\rho=2ρ=2 is independent of zzz,

∫01+x+y2 dz=2(1+x+y). \int_0^{1+x+y} 2\, dz = 2(1+x+y). ∫01+x+y​2dz=2(1+x+y).

Then the yyy-integration:

∫0x2(1+x+y) dy=2[(1+x)y+y22]0x=2(1+x)x+x. \int_0^{\sqrt{x}} 2(1+x+y)\, dy = 2\Big[(1+x)y + \tfrac{y^2}{2}\Big]_0^{\sqrt{x}} = 2(1+x)\sqrt{x} + x. ∫0x​​2(1+x+y)dy=2[(1+x)y+2y2​]0x​​=2(1+x)x​+x.

Finally the xxx-integration (using ∫01x1/2dx=23\int_0^1 x^{1/2}dx = \tfrac{2}{3}∫01​x1/2dx=32​, ∫01x3/2dx=25\int_0^1 x^{3/2}dx = \tfrac{2}{5}∫01​x3/2dx=52​, ∫01x dx=12\int_0^1 x\,dx = \tfrac{1}{2}∫01​xdx=21​):

M=∫01(2x+2x3/2+x) dx=2⋅23+2⋅25+12=43+45+12=7930. M = \int_0^1 \big(2\sqrt{x} + 2x^{3/2} + x\big)\, dx = 2\cdot\tfrac{2}{3} + 2\cdot\tfrac{2}{5} + \tfrac{1}{2} = \tfrac{4}{3} + \tfrac{4}{5} + \tfrac{1}{2} = \frac{79}{30}. M=∫01​(2x​+2x3/2+x)dx=2⋅32​+2⋅52​+21​=34​+54​+21​=3079​.

Step 1.3: Compute the moments and the center of mass.

Moment about the yzyzyz-plane (Myz=∭xρ dVM_{yz}=\iiint x\rho\,dVMyz​=∭xρdV).

∫01+x+y2x dz=2x(1+x+y). \int_0^{1+x+y} 2x\, dz = 2x(1+x+y). ∫01+x+y​2xdz=2x(1+x+y). ∫0x2x(1+x+y) dy=2x(1+x)x+x2. \int_0^{\sqrt{x}} 2x(1+x+y)\, dy = 2x(1+x)\sqrt{x} + x^2. ∫0x​​2x(1+x+y)dy=2x(1+x)x​+x2. Myz=∫01(2x3/2+2x5/2+x2) dx=2⋅25+2⋅27+13=179105. M_{yz} = \int_0^1 \big(2x^{3/2} + 2x^{5/2} + x^2\big)\, dx = 2\cdot\tfrac{2}{5} + 2\cdot\tfrac{2}{7} + \tfrac{1}{3} = \frac{179}{105}. Myz​=∫01​(2x3/2+2x5/2+x2)dx=2⋅52​+2⋅72​+31​=105179​.

Moment about the xzxzxz-plane (Mxz=∭yρ dVM_{xz}=\iiint y\rho\,dVMxz​=∭yρdV).

∫01+x+y2y dz=2y(1+x+y), \int_0^{1+x+y} 2y\, dz = 2y(1+x+y), ∫01+x+y​2ydz=2y(1+x+y), ∫0x2y(1+x+y) dy=2(1+x)x2+2x3/23=(1+x)x+23x3/2. \int_0^{\sqrt{x}} 2y(1+x+y)\, dy = 2(1+x)\frac{x}{2} + \frac{2x^{3/2}}{3} = (1+x)x + \tfrac{2}{3}x^{3/2}. ∫0x​​2y(1+x+y)dy=2(1+x)2x​+32x3/2​=(1+x)x+32​x3/2. Mxz=∫01(x+x2+23x3/2) dx=12+13+23⋅25=1110. M_{xz} = \int_0^1 \big(x + x^2 + \tfrac{2}{3}x^{3/2}\big)\, dx = \tfrac{1}{2} + \tfrac{1}{3} + \tfrac{2}{3}\cdot\tfrac{2}{5} = \frac{11}{10}. Mxz​=∫01​(x+x2+32​x3/2)dx=21​+31​+32​⋅52​=1011​.

Moment about the xyxyxy-plane (Mxy=∭zρ dVM_{xy}=\iiint z\rho\,dVMxy​=∭zρdV).

∫01+x+y2z dz=(1+x+y)2. \int_0^{1+x+y} 2z\, dz = (1+x+y)^2. ∫01+x+y​2zdz=(1+x+y)2. ∫0x(1+x+y)2 dy=[(1+x+y)33]0x=(1/3)[(1+x+x)3−(1+x)3]=13(3(1+x)2x+3x(1+x)+x3/2). \int_0^{\sqrt{x}} (1+x+y)^2\, dy = \Big[\tfrac{(1+x+y)^3}{3}\Big]_0^{\sqrt{x}} = (1/3)\Big[(1+x+\sqrt{x})^3 - (1+x)^3\Big] = \tfrac{1}{3}\Big(3(1+x)^2\sqrt{x} + 3x(1+x) + x^{3/2}\Big). ∫0x​​(1+x+y)2dy=[3(1+x+y)3​]0x​​=(1/3)[(1+x+x​)3−(1+x)3]=31​(3(1+x)2x​+3x(1+x)+x3/2).

Expanding, (1+x+x)3−(1+x)3=(3+6x+3x2)x+3x+3x2+x3/2, (1+x+\sqrt{x})^3 - (1+x)^3 = (3+6x+3x^2)\sqrt{x} + 3x + 3x^2 + x^{3/2}, (1+x+x​)3−(1+x)3=(3+6x+3x2)x​+3x+3x2+x3/2, so 13[(1+x+x)3−(1+x)3]=x+2x3/2+x5/2+x+x2+x3/23. \frac{1}{3}\Big[(1+x+\sqrt{x})^3-(1+x)^3\Big] = \sqrt{x} + 2x^{3/2} + x^{5/2} + x + x^2 + \tfrac{x^{3/2}}{3}. 31​[(1+x+x​)3−(1+x)3]=x​+2x3/2+x5/2+x+x2+3x3/2​. Integrating term by term (∫01xndx=1n+1\int_0^1 x^{n}dx = \tfrac{1}{n+1}∫01​xndx=n+11​):

Mxy=23+2⋅25+27+12+13+25⋅13=140+168+60+105+70+28210=571210. M_{xy} = \tfrac{2}{3} + 2\cdot\tfrac{2}{5} + \tfrac{2}{7} + \tfrac{1}{2} + \tfrac{1}{3} + \tfrac{2}{5}\cdot\tfrac{1}{3} = \frac{140+168+60+105+70+28}{210} = \frac{571}{210}. Mxy​=32​+2⋅52​+72​+21​+31​+52​⋅31​=210140+168+60+105+70+28​=210571​.

The center of mass is therefore xˉ=MyzM=179/10579/30=358553,yˉ=MxzM=11/1079/30=3379, \bar x = \frac{M_{yz}}{M} = \frac{179/105}{79/30} = \frac{358}{553}, \qquad \bar y = \frac{M_{xz}}{M} = \frac{11/10}{79/30} = \frac{33}{79}, xˉ=MMyz​​=79/30179/105​=553358​,yˉ​=MMxz​​=79/3011/10​=7933​, zˉ=MxyM=571/21079/30=571553. \bar z = \frac{M_{xy}}{M} = \frac{571/210}{79/30} = \frac{571}{553}. zˉ=MMxy​​=79/30571/210​=553571​.

M=3079​≈2.6333,(xˉ,yˉ​,zˉ)=(553358​, 7933​, 553571​)≈(0.6474, 0.4177, 1.0325).
